mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname, email, content, status, create_time, update_time FROM guest_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guest_message WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_message (nickname, email, content, status, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{nickname}, #{email}, #{content}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
